dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: Are you doing the football pools, Brian?
dialogue.zh: 布赖恩，你正在下足球赛的赌注吗？

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: Yes, I've nearly finished, Julie.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我这就做完了，朱莉。

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: I'm sure we'll win something this week.
dialogue.zh: 我敢肯定这星期我们会赢一点的。

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: You always say that,

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: but we never win anything!

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: What will you do if you win a lot of money?
dialogue.zh: 要是你赢了许多钱，你打算做什么呢？

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: If I win a lot of money

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: I'll buy you a mink coat.

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: I don't want a mink coat!

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: I want to see the world.

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: All right.

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: If we win a lot of money

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: we'll travel round the world

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: and we'll stay at the best hotels.

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: Then we'll return home

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: and buy a big house in the country.

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: We'll have a beautiful garden and . . .
dialogue.zh: 我们将有一个漂亮的花园和……

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: But if we spend all that money
dialogue.zh: 但是如果我们把所有钱都花光了，

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: we'll be poor again.

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: What'll we do then?

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: If we spend all the money
dialogue.zh: 如果我们花光了所有钱，

dialogue.speaker: Brian
dialogue.en: we'll try and win the football pools again.
dialogue.zh: 我们设法在足球赛赌注上再赢一次。

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: It's a pleasant dream

dialogue.speaker: Julie
dialogue.en: but everything depends on 'if'!

drills.en: If we win a lot of money, we ___ travel round the world.
drills.zh: 如果我们赢了很多钱，我们就去周游世界。

drills.en: If you break this window, you'll ___ to pay for it!
drills.zh: 如果你打破这扇窗户，你就得赔偿！

drills.en: If you don't hurry, we'll ___ the train.
drills.zh: 如果你不快点，我们就赶不上火车了。

drills.en: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ go to the seaside.
drills.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去海边了。
如果他摔下来，他会伤着自己的。

drills.en: If you feel better, you ___ get up.
drills.zh: 如果你觉得好些了，你就可以起床。

drills.en: What will you do if you ___ a lot of money?
drills.zh: 如果你赢了许多钱，你打算做什么？

drills.en: If he ___ his old car, he'll buy a new one.
drills.zh: 如果他卖掉旧车，他会买辆新的。
